name: leapware-runway
description: LEAPWare's own single-plugin marketplace. Hosts lwr, a token-policy layer that makes an AI coding session's spend rules mechanical.

plugins.name: lwr
plugins.description: A rate-limit runway plugin, set up here as a safe minimal skeleton: ships one no-op rule, lwr_version, which allows every event and reports the plugin's version. Policy is per-rule off/warn/deny and fails open. See plugins/claude/lwr/.claude-plugin/plugin.json for the full description.
